## Biography

Sarasvati. Named for an ancient river that flowed before recorded history, then vanished into desert.

The Equinox Project built observation platforms here — deep space monitoring arrays that required isogenic helium fluid routers and firmware no modern system can emulate. When GalCop collapsed in 3174, the project was abandoned. "No one was coming," they said. The platforms were not disassembled. They were left to rot in the dark.

John Ermitage did not accept that verdict. He sent contacts to Sarasvati after the last freelancers and "space selfie hunters" departed. Two GalCop arrays were recovered, repurposed, installed on the DW3 science carriers. Cal was furious when he learned: "You what?!" But Ermitage only smiled. Some technology is too valuable to let decay. Some rivers, even lost ones, can be made to flow again.
